title: Blankets for 60 families at the Riverbend school shelter
description: 60 wool blankets, one for each family sleeping on the school gym floor since the river flooded their homes. Nights are dropping below 10C. Bought from Valley Supply Co. and handed out at the shelter.

title: Three days of bottled water for the Eastside evacuation centre
description: The water main to the Eastside evacuation centre is broken. 400 people need drinking water for three days until it is repaired: 50 cases of bottled water (24 x 500ml bottles each), handed out at the door.

title: Hygiene kits for 120 people displaced by the flood
description: 120 hygiene kits - soap, toothbrush, toothpaste, sanitary pads and a towel in each - for people staying with relatives after losing their homes. Collected by each family.

title: Two weeks of baby formula for 25 families
description: 100 cans of infant formula (about 800g each) for 25 families with babies under one year old at the Riverbend shelter - four cans per family for two weeks. Shops nearby are closed, so it is bought in bulk.
